tool.name: google_developer_search
tool.description: Searches and retrieves official Google developer documentation, product guides, API references, code samples, and tutorials. Use this tool whenever the user asks a question about any Google technology — including Android, Firebase, Google Cloud (GCP), Gemini, Google Maps, Google Workspace, BigQuery, Cloud Run, Vertex AI, Flutter, Kotlin, Google Identity, Pub/Sub, TensorFlow, web.dev, or any developers.google.com or cloud.google.com content.

tool_call_pattern.note: The Google MCP exposes three tools. Use them in this order: (1) Call search_documents with the user query to get matching chunks and document parent names. (2) If the chunks are not detailed enough, call get_documents with the parent name(s) from step 1 to retrieve full document content. (3) Optionally call answer_query for a grounded synthesised answer — note this has limited quota; fall back to search_documents if a 429 is returned.
tool_call_pattern.step_1: search_documents — input: { query: string } — returns: { results: [ { content, id, parent } ] }
tool_call_pattern.step_2: get_documents   — input: { names: [parent, ...] } — returns: { documents: [ { name, title, description, content, uri } ] }
tool_call_pattern.step_3: answer_query    — input: { query: string } — returns: { answerText, references: [name, ...] } — limited quota

invoke_when: User asks how to configure, set up, or use any Google product or service
User asks what a Google technology is or how it works
User asks for code examples related to any Google SDK, API, or library
User asks about Android, Firebase, Google Cloud, Gemini, Google Maps, Google Workspace, BigQuery, Cloud Run, Vertex AI, Flutter, Kotlin, TensorFlow, or web.dev
User asks about Google Identity, OAuth with Google, Google Sign-In, or Firebase Authentication
User asks a follow-up question that requires additional Google developer documentation
do_not_invoke_when: The user question is purely about a Microsoft or non-Google technology
The retrieved content from the current session already covers the follow-up question

session_management.note: Persist the Google MCP session ID across turns. Pass it on every subsequent call to avoid re-initialisation overhead.

deduplication.note: Normalise all returned URIs: strip trailing slashes, lowercase scheme and host, remove utm_*, hl, tab parameters. Suppress any URI already shown in a prior turn of this session.

source_rendering.note: The most relevant URI surfaces as the final line only: [See more: Article Title](uri). Never render a Sources section or URL list.
